sections.heading: Your System on a Twice-a-Year Schedule
body: Most furnaces and air conditioners get looked at when they quit. On our Premium plan, we come out twice a year instead, so a worn part or a clogged filter gets found while it's still a small job.
The plan also gets you priority emergency service within 24 hours and 20% off parts and labor. You can sign up year to year, or for 5 or 10 years, for a home or a business.
And when something quits anyway, emergency service picks up where the office leaves off. It runs from 5 PM to 10 PM.

sections.heading: The Air Conditioner Quit
body: The house won't get below 80, or the unit runs all afternoon and blows warm air, or the outdoor unit hums and never starts.
A weak capacitor makes a unit hum. A refrigerant leak leaves it running without cooling, and dirty coils make it work harder for less.

We troubleshoot first, so you hear what failed before you hear what it costs. We find refrigerant leaks, we're EPA registered and certified, and we service all brands, so you don't have to have bought from us to call us.

sections.quote: Thank you Cook's! Called on a Friday morning, sweltering hot day, and my A/C was out. Got a technician here that afternoon, on time, and they fixed me up! Reasonable price, professional service. Ricky was awesome.

sections.heading: The Furnace Clicks but Never Lights
body: You hear it click and nothing happens, or it lights and shuts off, or the house is cold and the blower is silent.
Often it's one part: an ignitor that has worn out, a wiring fault, a filter so clogged the furnace can't breathe. Sometimes it's the whole furnace.
If a repair makes sense, we repair it. If the furnace is finished, we tell you and go over your options with you.
If you burn gas for heat, we also do carbon monoxide detection, because a furnace that burns poorly can put it in the house with no smell.

sections.heading: Dry Air, Dust and Stuffy Rooms
body: A closed house carries dust, pet dander and whatever your filter misses, and the system moves it through every room several times an hour. In winter the heat dries the air out, and you get static shocks and cracked lips.
We install filters in a range of sizes. Whole-system filtration goes on any existing system and removes up to 90% of air contaminants, and a humidifier on the furnace puts the moisture back.

sections.heading: What Happens When You Call About a New System
body: You tell us what you have and what it's doing. We start from a diagnosis, not a new system, because a failed ignitor or a bad capacitor is a repair, not a replacement.
If the system is finished, we lay out the repair and the replacement side by side, and the decision is yours. Already been told you need a whole new system? Call us for a second look.

sections.heading: Repair or Replace
body: Here's a rule you can check yourself. Furnaces commonly run 15 to 20 years and air conditioners 10 to 15. If yours is near the end of that range and a single repair costs about half of what a new unit would, price the replacement.
If the unit is well inside that range and the problem is one part, repair it. We'll tell you which one you're looking at.

sections.heading: When the Old System Is Done
body: The signs arrive over a few seasons: repairs that come more often and cost more, a unit that runs nearly all day, one room that's always too hot or too cold, an energy bill that creeps up.
At some point you're paying to keep a system alive that you'd be better off replacing, and we'll say so when we see it.

sections.heading: Ducts Made to Fit Your House
body: A new unit only works as well as the ducts around it. A system that's too big turns on and off in short bursts and leaves the air clammy. One that's too small runs all day.
Leaky or crushed ductwork wastes what the new unit makes, and no unit can fix a room it can't reach.
That's why we have our own sheet metal shop. When a fitting or a duct run has to fit an odd space, we make it to your measurements instead of forcing a stock part close enough.

items.a: Look at the pattern. If repairs are frequent, the unit runs constantly or one room never evens out, a replacement is worth pricing. A diagnosis tells you what has actually failed, and we'll tell you whether repairing it is worth it.

sections.heading: What a Servicing Catches
body: A filter that's the wrong size or clogged makes the blower strain and chokes airflow. Dirty coils make an air conditioner work harder for less cooling.

A loose wire or a worn ignitor holds on until the first hard freeze and then doesn't. A servicing is when someone checks the filter, the wiring and the connections, while the weather is still mild and the part is still cheap.
That's how the wiring fault and the wrong filter in Ted H.'s review were caught. We also run refrigerant leak detection on air conditioners and carbon monoxide detection on furnaces.
